what: Prints a photo (a background-removed PNG) or text onto the panel as dots at a chosen spacing (6px) with radius 1.5px — each dot takes the color at its spot. At first the dots are scattered ±4px and then gather, and dots within 120px around the cursor are pushed away by (120 − distance)/120 × 15, then pulled back to place by .08 per frame with .85 damping, bouncing as they return. Drawing pauses when offscreen or when everything has stopped

options.ret: Share pulled back into place (per frame), default .08
options.radius: Radius pushed by the cursor (px), default 120
options.flip: if true, the photo is shot mirrored left to right
options.color: In text mode, the accent color when accent is on (defaults to the element’s text color)
options.[data-fx-part=source]: To mark with a dot (must be the same origin to read pixels). If none, the element’s text is drawn at 80% of the panel height
options.falloff: cubic: face push strength as 1 − (distance/perimeter)³ — only nearby points push hard, the edge of the perimeter barely moves (Studio footer). Default is linear (1 − distance/perimeter)
options.drag: Share of cursor speed added to the dots, default 0 — microdose .15 (speed keeps .7 of the old and takes .3 of the new each frame)
options.shape: square: a size×size square instead of a round dot — microdose 2px
options.scatter: Initial scatter spread (±px), default 4 — 0 starts in place
options.span: In text mode, fit the word width to this share of the board width (instead of 80% of height when given) — microdose .78, the bottom may be cropped outside the board
options.top: In text mode, put the top edge of the text this many px below the top of the panel (instead of centered) — microdose 40

note: Touch is not hijacked (touch-action: pan-y) — swiping vertically scrolls the page. Photo mode only reads images from the same origin (from another origin it quietly draws nothing)
